tone.description: Colour and icon. Danger uses role="alert"; the rest use role="status".

title.description: Headline. A new title rises in over the old one.

children.description: Details under the title. String children crossfade when they change.

open.description: Controls presence. Hiding collapses the height and fades it out.

onDismiss.description: Shows a dismiss button. Uncontrolled alerts collapse first, then call this.
